top_signals.title: Xi, Trump and Putin Wrap Historic Trilateral in China
top_signals.summary:
Chinese President Xi Jinping hosted what he called a “groundbreaking” discussion with Presidents Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin on Thursday in Shenzhen, China.

The discussion spanned issues from Ukraine and denuclearization to the management of major-power disputes. Annmarie Hordern has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Five warning signs of ransomware breach before encryption or data theft
top_signals.summary: Ransomware attacks often involve credential theft, lateral movement, and attempts to disable security controls long before encryption begins. Acronis examines five warning signs that can help defenders detect intrusions earlier, contain malicious activity, and protect critical systems and backups. [...]

top_signals.title: Ivy League University Endowments Grow to $250 Billion
top_signals.summary: Ivy League universities have never been richer. Their combined endowments more than doubled over the past decade to nearly $250 billion.
